description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will be a Registered Nurse with a passion for clinical excellence and team leadership.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and supporting the Director of Nursing. This position is perfect for a leader who thrives in a dynamic setting and is committed to fostering a positive and efficient healthcare environment. We value strong clinical judgment, effective communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.This full-time opportunity provides a competitive salary range of $60,000 to $75,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Join a team dedicated to making a difference in the lives of residents and contributing to a culture of compassionate care.
requirements: Current RN license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.
